Two ways Lyfos could look.

Pick a direction by spending 30 seconds in each. The Home screen is where most users live, so it's the right place to decide. Both prototypes are at production fidelity — typography, color, motion, copy.

Direction A

Quiet Archive

Editorial minimalism. Serif headlines, hairlines, near-zero color. Reads like a slim book about your life.

Serif headlines Paper tone One accent
Direction B

Soft ConciergeMobile

Warm, gentle, mobile-first. Cards, soft shadows, light illustration. A kind assistant, not an enterprise tool.

Sans humanist Warm gradient Three accents
Tip: try each one at full-screen, then resize the window to see how it feels on mobile.
